faq.q: How does Cekat.AI help clinics and healthcare businesses?
faq.a: It answers patient chats instantly 24/7 on WhatsApp, Instagram, and web chat, handling appointment requests, service questions, and pricing, while organizing every conversation in one platform. Staff focus on patients in the room, not the phone.

faq.q: Can patients book appointments through the AI?
faq.a: Yes. Through API integration with your scheduling system, the AI books, confirms, and reschedules appointments directly in the chat, and automated reminders go out before the visit to reduce no-shows.

faq.q: What happens when a question is too complex or sensitive for AI?
faq.a: The conversation escalates to your staff automatically, with the full chat history attached. Your team answers medical or sensitive questions; the AI handles the routine volume around them.

Cekat.AI complies with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) in handling and managing user data. Access within your team is role-based, so conversation data is only visible to the people who should see it.

faq.q: What results have healthcare businesses seen with Cekat.AI?
faq.a: Vio Optical Clinic grew revenue +50% compared to the previous month after implementing Cekat.AI, with customer service fully handled by AI and 24/7 support, after previously drowning in manual chats during a demand surge.

faq.q: Which channels can a clinic connect?
faq.a: WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, and website live chat, all flowing into one inbox with a single interaction history per patient, so no inquiry falls between channels.

faq.q: How long does setup take for a clinic?
faq.a: The AI agent is built by pasting your clinic's SOPs and service information, most teams have it answering accurately in minutes, not weeks. No coding is required at any step.

faq.q: Can Cekat.AI handle multiple branches or departments?
faq.a: Yes. You can organize human agents into teams with role-based access, create specialized AI agents per service line, and route conversations to the right branch or department automatically.

faq.q: Does it also help clinics with promotions and follow-ups?
faq.a: Yes. Broadcast campaigns reach patient segments through the official WhatsApp API, checkup reminders, seasonal promos, replenishment nudges, with automated follow-ups based on each patient's activity.
